rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for circular, spherical, approximately circular, or smoothly curved shapes.

example.english: This cake is big and round.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 jau6 daai6 jau6 jyun4

rows.note: Use 屈 as the all-purpose verb for making something curved or for an object becoming bent.

example.english: I used my hands to round the wire into a loop.
example.traditional: 我用手將條鐵線屈成一個圈。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 sau2 zoeng1 tiu4 tit3 sin3 wat1 sing4 jat1 go3 hyun1

rows.note: Use 一輪 as the all-purpose choice for a shared round of drinks or a stage of a competition.

example.english: I’ll buy everyone a round tonight.
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ngo5 cing2 daai6 gaa1 jam2 jat1 leon4

rows.note: Use 四捨五入 specifically when rounding a number to the nearest whole number or place value.

example.english: Round the answer to the nearest whole number.
example.traditional: 個答案要四捨五入到最接近嘅整數。
example.jyutping: go3 daap3 on3 jiu3 sei3 se2 ng5 jap6 dou3 zeoi3 zip3 gan6 ge3 zing2 sou3

rows.note: Use 發 for one ammunition round or shot, as in 一發子彈.

example.english: They fired a round into the air, and our whole group jumped.
example.traditional: 佢向天開咗一發，嚇到我哋成班跳起。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hoeng3 tin1 hoi1 zo2 jat1 faat3 haak3 dou3 ngo5 dei6 seng4 baan1 tiu3 hei2

rows.note: Use 回合 for a timed segment of a match, especially in boxing or wrestling.

example.english: The boxing match stopped in the third round.
example.traditional: 呢場拳賽打到第三回合就停咗。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 kyun4 coi3 daa2 dou3 dai6 saam1 wui4 hap6 zau6 ting4 zo2

rows.note: Use 一陣掌聲 for a burst or round of applause from an audience.

example.english: A round of applause broke out after the guest finished speaking.
example.traditional: 嘉賓講完之後，全場響起一陣掌聲。
example.jyutping: gaa1 ban1 gong2 jyun4 zi1 hau6 cyun4 coeng4 hoeng2 hei2 jat1 zan6 zoeng2 sing1

rows.note: Use 轉過 when someone turns or passes around a corner or other boundary.

example.english: We round the corner and see the shop.
example.traditional: 我哋轉過街角就見到間舖。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zyun2 gwo3 gaai1 gok3 zau6 gin3 dou2 gaan1 pou3

rows.note: Use 來回 before a trip or journey noun when it goes back to its starting point.

example.english: I bought a round-trip ticket to Guangzhou.
example.traditional: 我買咗張去廣州嘅來回機票。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 heoi3 gwong2 zau1 ge3 loi4 wui4 gei1 piu3

rows.note: Use 圍住 when something encircles or surrounds something else.

example.english: The people are eating round the table.
example.jyutping: di1 jan4 wai4 zyu6 zoeng1 toi2 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use 夠整 for a number that is conveniently neat or ends in a zero.

example.english: The price is a nice round number, so there is no need to find change.
example.traditional: 呢個價錢夠整，唔使搵散紙。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 gau3 zing2 m4 sai2 wan2 saan3 zi2
